attempts.text:
**The window starts in the `kdp` operon.** Columns 0 to 5 are spine, carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 5% of calls: `kdpF`, `kdpA`, `kdpB`, `kdpC`, `kdpD` and `kdpE`, [[potassium transport]]. The model names 95 to 99.8% of them, fewest at `kdpC`, 95%, and hesitates most at `kdpD`, 0.37 bits.

**Then the most hesitant stretch of the window.** Columns 6 to 10 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 45 to 76% of calls, and the model names only 56 to 95% there. Column 6, `speFL`, is the most hesitant of all, 1.17 bits, named 56%; `speF` and `potE` follow, [[ornithine and putrescine metabolism]], with a DUF2625 family protein and a hypothetical protein.

**A long spine follows**, columns 11 to 19, 94% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 2 to 14% of calls, named 95 to 99%: `pgm` to `glnS`. Then column 20, a variable column, in a region of plasticity in 10% of calls, named 87%, 0.47 bits, a DeoR/GlpR family DNA-binding transcript. Columns 21 to 37 are spine again, 91 to 94%, named 76 to 99%, through the `nag` and `glt` genes, [[glucosamine catabolism]] and [[glutamate and aspartate transport]].

**The middle opens into variable columns 38 to 44**, carried by 57 to 65% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 38 to 60% of calls, named 70 to 87%: `hscC` to `ybeQ`, [[chaperone and tetratricopeptide proteins]]. Columns 45 to 58 are spine, 93%, named 85 to 99%, no column above 0.15 bits, `ybeL` to `lipB`, [[peptidoglycan synthesis]].

**The window ends quietly.** Columns 67 to 77 are the least plastic, spine, in a region of plasticity in 2 to 3% of calls, named 91 to 97%, `dcuC` to `rna`, [[citrate fermentation]]. The last two columns are fork: `rnk` in 89% and `uspG` in 57%, where the window ends. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 0.70 against 0.15 bits, and names fewer genes, 70% against 96%.

label: kdpF
facts:
WINDOW: the kdpF window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor kdpF, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,044 to 3,123 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying kdpF once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.22 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 35,411 calls, named 98%, 0.11 bits; shell 7,670 calls, named 71%, 0.67 bits; cloud 119 calls, named 3%, 3.18 bits. Outside an RGP 37,780 calls, named 96%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 5,420 calls, named 70%, 0.70 bits. Columns: 61 spine, 3 fork, 16 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.70 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (70% against 96%); 5,420 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 6 (speFL) 1.17 bits, RGP 76%; column 9 ("DUF2625 family protein") 0.62 bits, RGP 74%; column 20 ("DeoR/GlpR family DNA-binding transcript…") 0.47 bits, RGP 10%. The 9 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 81%, 0.46 bits on average; the other 71 columns: named 94%, 0.19 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 6-10 (fork and variable columns), RGP 45-76%; the least: columns 67-77 (spine), RGP 2-3%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-5 (6 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0-5%. Genes: kdpF "K(+)-transporting ATPase subunit F", kdpA, kdpB, kdpC, kdpD, kdpE. named 95-99.8% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 3 (kdpC), named 95%; most hesitant at column 4 (kdpD), 0.37 bits.
2. columns 6-10 (5 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 45-76%. named 56-95% (mean 83%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 6, named 56%, 1.17 bits.
   6 fork: speFL S 78% "leader peptide SpeFL"; also "hypothetical protein" S 31%, "IS1-like element transposase" S 26%
   7 variable: speF S 68%
   8 variable: potE S 76%
   9 variable: "DUF2625 family protein" S 52%
   10 variable: "hypothetical protein" S 64%
3. columns 11-19 (9 columns) spine: share 94%, all P, RGP 2-14%. Genes: pgm, seqA, ybfF "esterase", ybfE "LexA regulated protein", fldA, uof, fur, chiQ, glnS. named 95-99% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 19 (glnS), named 95%, 0.25 bits.
4. column 20 variable: RGP 10%. named 87%; 0.47 bits.
   20: "DeoR/GlpR family DNA-binding transcript…" S 9%
5. columns 21-37 (17 columns) spine: share 91-94%, all P, RGP 2-23%. Genes: nagE "PTS transporter subunit EIIC", nagB, nagA, nagC, nagD, asnB, ubiF, miaB, ybeZ "nucleoside triphosphate hydrolase", ybeY "rRNA maturation RNase YbeY", corC, lnt, gltI, gltJ "glutamate/aspartate ABC transporter…", gltK, gltL, rihA. named 76-99% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 35 (gltK), named 76%; most hesitant at column 21 (nagE), 0.35 bits.
6. columns 38-44 (7 columns) variable: RGP 38-60%. named 70-87% (mean 80%), fewest named at column 43, named 70%; most hesitant at column 39, 0.45 bits.
   columns 38-44, share 57-65%, all S: hscC 64%, djlC 62%, ybeU "DUF1266 domain-containing protein" 63%, ybeT "tetratricopeptide repeat protein" 64%, djlB 57%, ybeR "DUF1266 domain-containing protein" 64%, ybeQ "tetratricopeptide repeat protein" 65%
7. columns 45-58 (14 columns) spine: share 93%, all P, RGP 0.4-23%. Genes: ybeL "zinc ribbon-containing protein", leuS, lptE, holA, nadD, cobC, rsfS, rlmH, mrdA "peptidoglycan DD-transpeptidase MrdA", mrdB, rlpA, dacA, ybeD "DUF493 family protein YbeD", lipB. named 85-99% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 45 (ybeL), named 85%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.15 bits (column 58 (lipB)).
8. columns 59-60 (2 columns) variable: RGP 2-3%. named 96%; most hesitant at column 60, 0.22 bits.
   59: ybeF S 80% "YbeF family transcriptional regulat…"
   60: ybhH S 5% "PrpF domain-containing protein"
9. columns 61-62 (2 columns) spine: share 93%, all P, RGP 4%. Genes: lipA, tatE. named 93%; most hesitant at column 61 (lipA), 0.26 bits.
10. column 63 variable: RGP 3%. named 95%; 0.25 bits.
   63: ybeM S 77% "nitrilase-related carbon-nitrogen h…"
11. columns 64-65 (2 columns) spine: share 93%, all P, RGP 3%. Genes: crcB, cspE. named 95%; most hesitant at column 65 (cspE), 0.24 bits.
12. column 66 variable: RGP 3%. named 96%; 0.29 bits.
   66: pagP P 90%
13. columns 67-77 (11 columns) spine: share 91-93%, all P, RGP 2-3%. Genes: dcuC, dpiA "two-component response regulator Dp…", dpiB, citC, citD, citE, citF, citX "citrate lyase holo-[acyl-carrier pr…", citG, citT, rna. named 91-97% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 74 (citX), named 91%; most hesitant at column 77 (rna), 0.30 bits.
14. columns 78-79 (2 columns) fork: RGP 2-3%. named 91%; most hesitant at column 79, 0.38 bits.
   78: rnk P 89%; also ybdR S 47%, dsbG P 27%, ybdL P 11%
   79: uspG P 57%; also ahpF P 41%, yldA S 23%, citR P 21%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): kdpA potassium-transporting ATPase subunit K…; kdpB potassium-transporting ATPase subunit K…; kdpC K(+)-transporting ATPase subunit C; kdpD ATP-binding protein; kdpE winged helix-turn-helix domain-containi…; speF Orn/Lys/Arg decarboxylase N-terminal do…; nagB glucosamine-6-phosphate deaminase; nagA N-acetylglucosamine-6-phosphate deacety…; nagD HAD hydrolase-like protein; gltI glutamate/aspartate ABC transporter sub…; gltK glutamate/aspartate ABC transporter per…; gltL glutamate/aspartate ABC transporter ATP…; mrdB peptidoglycan glycosyltransferase MrdB; dpiB ATP-binding protein; citC adenylyltransferase/cytidyltransferase…; citE citrate (pro-3S)-lyase subunit beta; citG triphosphoribosyl-dephospho-CoA synthase; citT citrate/succinate antiporter CitT; ahpC alkyl hydroperoxide reductase subunit C; ybdM ParB/RepB/Spo0J family partition protein; ybdR alcohol dehydrogenase catalytic domain-…; dsbG thiol:disulfide interchange protein DsbG; ybdL methionine-oxo-acid transaminase; ahpF FAD-dependent oxidoreductase; citR LysR substrate-binding domain-containin…
END: the window ends at column 79, uspG, in 57% of chromosomes.
